title: 3D file Viewer
description: Since college I have been fascinated with how the 3D pipeline operates. Before I started working in DirectX 5.0, I attempted to tackle 3D myself using Turbo C++. I got as far as matrices, FOV, culling, z-buffering, lighting and rasterization. I then translated the code to Java as well as C# and constructed a DirectX, OBJ and 3DS file viewer.  Later I used this technique to display 3D objects in an environment where I don't have native access to the 3D accelerator such a Java2D applet.
